rappel_detail.anchor: fixed bolted anchor (a single newer bolt backed up)
rappel_detail.station: The top of the short crux chimney, reached by downclimbing about 100 ft of Class 3 from the summit.
rappel_detail.notes: The one rappel, about 30 ft down the chimney (5.6 moves); a 60 m rope is plenty. Most parties rappel rather than downclimb, especially when the shaded rock is wet or mossy.
